pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "TURKISH CHILLI SCRAMBLED EGGS", "rating": 3 } --- The scrambled eggs were delicious. ``` ```menu { "title": "DOUBLE CHEESEBURGER", "rating": 3 } --- A burger with thick patties and layers of cheese stacked high. ``` ## Review This is the village of Leura, which we stopped at for lunch on the way back from the Featherdale Wildlife Park and Blue Mountains tour. Having searched ahead before arriving in town, we were able to head straight to the restaurant as soon as we got there. We ordered `TURKISH CHILLI SCRAMBLED EGGS` and `DOUBLE CHEESEBURGER`. Nothing on the menu stood out, so after a long deliberation we settled on the safe-looking burger. The burger came with fries, and the staff asked about our choice of sauce. Nothing came to mind, so we asked for a recommendation and they showed us the options directly. We were curious about `BBQ sauce` but were wondering if it would pair well with fries — the staff said it was a good choice, so we went with `BBQ sauce`. It actually went surprisingly well with the fries, and we were happy with it. ```adcard ``` After the meal, we asked about dessert as well, but it was raining outside and the timing was awkward — too in-between for a separate cafe trip — so we ordered coffee instead. It turned out the person taking our dessert order was Korean, so being able to order comfortably in Korean was a pleasant surprise. Overall, it was a great spot to unwind after the tour. ## Pictures
